component.name: Tooltip
component.description: Hover-triggered informational overlay anchored to a trigger element.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Tooltip bubble positioned next to its trigger.

slots.name: text
slots.description: Primary text region inside the tooltip bubble.

slots.name: kbds
slots.description: Container for shortcut hints displayed beside tooltip text.

slots.name: kbd
slots.description: Individual keyboard key hint inside the tooltip.

own.name: children
own.description: Render the tooltip trigger as a single HTMLElement root.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: closeDelay
own.description: Delay in milliseconds before closing after leaving trigger or content.

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether trigger interactions and content rendering are disabled.

own.name: forceMount
own.description: Whether content remains mounted while closed.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier used to derive the content id.

own.name: instantOpenDelay
own.description: Delay in milliseconds to skip the open delay for the next trigger after closing.

own.name: invert
own.description: Whether to use the inverted foreground-on-background color treatment.

own.name: kbds
own.description: Keyboard shortcuts to display next to the text.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

own.name: openDelay
own.description: Delay in milliseconds before opening on hover or focus.

own.name: placement
own.description: Preferred content placement relative to the trigger.

own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["span"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: side
own.description: Visual side styles applied after the positioned placement is resolved.
